notes: Centre list scraped read-only from Wafid's public 'Medical Centers List' page (GET filter country=BD, 6 pages x 50, 261 entries). No login needed.
Wafid's public list shows no centre code/ID, so 'id' is null for every centre.
City names are as Wafid spells them ('Chitagong' = Chattogram); city_slug is our URL slug.
Phone/email/website are exactly as listed by Wafid for candidates; some phones look malformed (e.g. '+0821...') and are kept verbatim.
Listing on Wafid does not by itself prove the centre is currently taking appointments; Wafid assigns the centre automatically for Standard bookings.

steps_en: Open https://wafid.com/ and tap 'Book an Appointment'.
Choose the country (where the exam happens), the city, and the country you are travelling to.
Choose appointment type: Standard ($10, centre assigned automatically by city) or Premium ($25, you choose the medical centre and appointment date).

Enter candidate information (name, date of birth, nationality, gender, marital status, passport number/issue date/place/expiry, visa type, email, phone, position applied for), verify the OTP sent to your email, confirm the information is correct and submit.
Pay by card on the payment page (card expiry is entered year then month, YYMM) and tap 'Pay'.
After you receive the medical exam slip, visit the medical centre as soon as possible to do the examination.
slip_reprint_steps_en: From the print GCC slip tab, enter passport number and nationality, then tap generate.
faq_points_en: Standard booking: the applicant cannot choose the centre; it is assigned automatically by city and country.
City can be changed only after the current slip expires (validity is printed on the slip); then generate a new slip.
The examination date cannot be changed.
If wrong data was entered, ask the medical centre to submit a free 'Change candidate details' / 'Change medical exam request'; no fee should be paid for it.
If a valid medical report already exists, a new appointment can be booked 2 months after the date of that report.
Applicants of any age can book.

status_check.method_en: Search by passport number + nationality, or by Wafid/GCC slip number.
status_check.result_time_en: Wafid FAQ: the medical examination result appears within 26 days.

fee.value: Wafid appointment fee: USD 10 (Standard) or USD 25 (Premium), paid online to Wafid.
fee.source: https://wafid.com/en/book-appointment/ ; https://wafid.com/en/faq/ ('$10 per applicant for an appointment')

exam_fee_at_centre.reason: Neither Wafid nor the GHC regulations publish the amount Bangladeshi centres charge for the medical examination itself; no official BMET/Ministry figure found in this pass.

validity.value: 2 months from the issue date of the medical certificate (for issuing or approving the visa).
validity.citation: Regulations of Medical Examination of Expatriates Coming to GCC States for Work or Residence, Sixth Version 2021, Article 42
other_rules: Article 45: medical examination applies to all expatriates coming for work or residence except those under 16; vaccination card must be attached.
After arrival, the GCC country's Ministry of Health re-examines the expatriate (Article 43).

infectious_en: Any abnormal chest X-ray change, including active or past pulmonary tuberculosis; pulmonary cavitation, fibrosis or calcification; pleural effusion or condensation; lymphadenopathy
non_communicable_en: Any distortion, amputation or physical disability impeding work
others_en: Pregnancy, when applying for a work visa
